Troubleshoot and resolve customer-impacting issues, security vulnerabilities, release blockers, and production-quality defects. Mentor junior engineers.

Minimum Qualifications
Bachelors degree in STEM with 5+ years of experience or Master's degree in STEM with 3+ years of experience. Programming experience with languages such as Python or Go. Experience with automated testing, CI/CD workflows, source control, code review, and release practices. Experience in software design, data structures, algorithms, REST APIs, debugging, testing.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Splunk platform, Splunk Enterprise Security, SPL, security analytics, detection engineering. Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts, data normalization, security schemas, or frameworks such as CIM or OCSF.

jobs.description:

Meet the Team
The Common Hardware Group (CHG) at Cisco is seeking skilled software engineers to join our Diagnostic/BSP team, responsible for ensuring the reliability and performance of our world-class hardware. Our team develops software for Cisco's network switches and routers, which feature advanced application awareness to build a flexible and agile network infrastructure, supporting multi-layered responses to AI and ML workload demands.

Your Impact
Architect, design, and develop BIOS, BSP, and Diagnostics for Cisco Core and Edge routing products. Design, develop, and test kernel and user space device drivers for FPGA and networking peripherals. Develop and execute software test plans. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to debug prototypes and validate software. Lead technical reviews and discussions across teams.

Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field with 10+ years experience, or Master's degree with 8+ years experience. Prior experience in C, C++, and Python programming. Previous experience with hardware and device driver development background, including Linux hardware bring-up. Prior experience with Sonic, ONIE, BMC, IPMI, and/or Redfish technologies. Prior experience in developing, debugging, and validating embedded systems and device drivers for protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, PCIe, and/or GPIO.

Preferred Skills
Proficient in kernel debugging tools such as GDB and KGDB. Prior experience developing software from concept through delivery for large-scale, high-bandwidth systems. Knowledge of Layer 2/3 network protocols. Experience with network processors and optical networking. Familiarity with secure-boot, open-source tools, CMIS, and SFF standards.

In your first year: Ramp on platform hardware/software stack, safety requirements, hypervisor deployments. Deliver architecture recommendation for hypervisor strategy. Characterize behavior on target hardware. Stand up instrumentation for timing/utilization/VM health visibility.

Essential Job Duties: Define virtualization safety architecture for mixed-criticality system. Prototype and evaluate Xen and QNX hypervisors. Own hypervisor system configuration and integration. Architect deterministic inter-VM communication and device virtualization (virtio, shared memory, PCIe passthrough). Lead failure modes and effects analysis. Build platform observability.

Required Skills: Demonstrated expertise designing scalable, high-performance embedded software architectures; advanced C++ and Python for real-time systems. Extensive experience in Linux/QNX environments (kernel modules, resource managers, POSIX). Proven expertise with FPGAs, hardware accelerators, PCIe. Bachelor's/Master's/PhD in EE, Computer Engineering, CS or related; 12 years experience with Bachelor's, 8 with Master's, or PhD with 5 years.

Preferred: Experience with Xen internals. Functional safety/regulatory standards (ISO 26262, IEC 61508, DO-178C, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 60601).

Compensation: Base Compensation Range Region 1: $223,900-$322,100; Region 2: $190,300-$273,800. Onsite weekly, day shift.
